subject: Marketplace listing: buyer approval tiers, term length options & co-sell entitlements
messages:

To: Sophie Turner <sophie.turner@novarx.com>, Novarx Procurement <procurement@novarx.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 2 May 2028 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Marketplace listing: buyer approval tiers, term length options & co-sell entitlements

Hi Sophie / Procurement team —

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. We had a follow-up internally and wanted to align on a couple things that will drive whether we go via a Private Offer or a standard listing with co-sell. Quick points that would help scope the right path: 

- Approx expected ARR for year 1 (ballpark) and whether Novarx prefers annual commit vs usage-on-bill.
- Any procurement thresholds requiring CFO/Board signoff (e.g., deals > $100k require CFO).
- Term flexibility: are you evaluating 12, 18, or 24 month commitments? Longer term typically unlocks additional marketplace discounts & co-sell promotion.
- Evidence pack: procurement requested SOC 2 + data residency notes — attaching our standard checklist and a draft pricing spreadsheet for transparency.

Attachment: redwood_marketplace_pricing_terms_v1.xlsx (xlsx)
Attachment: Novarx_PO_Checklist.pdf (pdf)

Proposed next steps: if you can confirm approval gating (thresholds + signers) and target term length, Vanessa and I will put together a Private Offer proposal with recommended discount tiers and co-sell entitlements (joint marketing, listing prominence, sales enablement).

Thanks — happy to jump on a quick call this week if helpful.

—Marcus
Marcus Lin
Principal Sales, Marketplace
Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0123
From: Sophie Turner <sophie.turner@novarx.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Novarx Procurement <procurement@novarx.com>
Date: Thu, 2 May 2028 11:03:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Marketplace listing: buyer approval tiers, term length options & co-sell entitlements

Thanks Marcus — appreciate the clear list. A few clarifications from our side: 

- Ballpark: we're modeling ~$85k ARR in year one for the pilot scope we discussed (single BU). If the pilot scales to 3 BUs, that could grow to ~350k ARR.
- Procurement thresholds: anything over $100k requires CFO signoff; additional legal review happens for contract terms longer than 18 months.
- Term preference: procurement usually pushes for 12 or 24 months; 18 months is possible but not the default. Our procurement lead prefers 12 months for pilots.
- Evidence: attaching our procurement requirements doc — SOC 2 Type II required, data residency in US only for now.

Attachment: novarx_procurement_requirements.pdf (pdf)

If you can propose an options matrix (12/18/24 mo) with the expected discount and what co-sell support looks like for each, we can route it through procurement and the CFO if we breach the 100k threshold. Happy to take a 20-minute call Friday if that helps accelerate.

Best,
Sophie
Sophie Turner
Head of Platform Partnerships, Novarx
sophie.turner@novarx.com
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 2 May 2028 13:14:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Marketplace listing: buyer approval tiers, term length options & co-sell entitlements

Marcus / Naomi —

Thanks for looping me in. Quick internal thoughts before we draft options for Novarx: 

- Levers we can use: % discount vs. credited marketplace marketing funds vs. joint case study guarantee. For a pilot under $100k, keep discount conservative (5–8%) and offer co-sell enablement; for >$100k or 24-month commit we can move to 12–18% discount.
- Buyer approval gating: if CFO signoff kicks in at >$100k, pricing for the 12 mo at ~$85k should avoid escalation. If they want 24 mo, pricing calculus needs to account for NPV and support costs.
- Term tradeoffs: suggest we present three clean options (12/18/24) so procurement has a straightforward decision tree. For 18 mo we can position as a midpoint: moderate discount (10%), limited marketing fund, and faster activation.
- Co-sell entitlements: make sure partner listing is in the co-sell program (requires Marketplace listing + partner enablement checklist). We should promise one webinar and an AWS EBC intro for the 24 mo tier.

Action items (who/when):
- Marcus: draft the 12/18/24 matrix and include estimated list price, marketplace discount, and co-sell items (today EOD).
- Naomi: pull the latest co-sell enablement checklist and confirm activation lead times (tomorrow).

Vanessa
VP, Global Marketplace
Redwood Inference
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Sophie Turner <sophie.turner@novarx.com>, Novarx Procurement <procurement@novarx.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 4 May 2028 16:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Marketplace listing: buyer approval tiers, term length options & co-sell entitlements

Hi Sophie / Procurement —

Thanks for the quick responses and the procurement doc. Per Vanessa's ask, attached is a short options matrix for the three term buckets we discussed. High level: 

- 12 months: list price = $95k; marketplace private-offer discount = 6%; co-sell: standard enablement (listing + enablement pack); avoids CFO signoff at current forecast.
- 18 months: list price (annualized) = $90k; effective discount = 10% across the committed term; includes one joint webinar, a 3-month co-marketing fund ($5k credit), and prioritized intake for co-sell referrals. Would likely still sit under CFO threshold depending on total ARR.
- 24 months: list price (annualized) = $82k; effective discount = 15%; includes expanded co-sell (webinar + AWS EBC intros), $12k marketing credit, and executive briefing. Requires CFO signoff if annualized ARR > $100k.

We can route any selected option as a Private Offer through AWS Marketplace (we'll submit draft pricing/terms and link to DocuSign). If procurement wants to keep it on standard listing, we can do that too but co-sell entitlements are more limited.

DocuSign for a draft Private Offer: https://docusign.com/envelope/ABC123456789
HubSpot record: https://hubspot.company/contacts/HS-908234

Attachment: Novarx_PO_Checklist.pdf (pdf)
Attachment: redwood_marketplace_pricing_terms_v1.xlsx (xlsx)

Please let me know which option you prefer and we'll prepare the Private Offer for signature. If you prefer a short call to finalize, Vanessa is available Monday morning PST.

Thanks — looking forward to getting Novarx live.

—Marcus
